regressions.what: A nearly continuous black slit and regularly spaced fans of pale roots now trace the turf edge, making its outline more conspicuous than before.

blockers.target: Broken blue-grey sky reflections follow the current around all three rocks and continue over visible gravel to the bottom edge.
blockers.current: Brown gravel dominates the foreground and diffuse grey patches beside the rocks provide the only visible indication of flow.
blockers.change: Carry narrow blue-grey reflections around both flanks of each rock and spread them toward both lower corners with clear gravel between the streaks.

blockers.target: The shaded downstream faces retain grey stone colour and individual fissures are visible.
blockers.current: The downstream faces are nearly black across their lower halves while the upper faces are bright.
blockers.change: Lift indirect illumination of the downstream faces until their major fissures are legible at the comparison-sheet size.

blockers.target: Dark brown earth extends from the hanging turf down to a shaded gravel toe.
blockers.current: A thin black slit sits over a brightly lit tan shelf.
blockers.change: Spread soft shadow from the turf lip down most of the earth face and let it fade across the lower cobbles.

blockers.target: Soft olive reflections from the far shore reach toward the middle of the lake in vertical patches cut by fine horizontal ripples.
blockers.current: A narrow dark shoreline reflection gives way to broad blue and tan patches, including a conspicuous pale patch near the right bank.
blockers.change: Extend the olive reflection roughly halfway to the outlet rocks and break up the right-hand tan patch with short horizontal ripples.

blockers.target: Two turquoise drops have white centers and cast a soft pale reflection broken into horizontal bands.
blockers.current: The falls contain disconnected white wedges and the reflection repeats their sharp contours.
blockers.change: Connect the white centers down both tiers, add a thin white impact line at the lake and blur the reflection horizontally.

next.target: Fine roots hang down a recessed earth face and scattered rounded stones are embedded at its foot.
next.current: Coarse pale roots lie in repeated fans across an almost flat shelf and cobbles follow its upper surface.
next.change: Cut a steeper recessed face, hang roots of varied lengths from irregular gaps and embed separated cobbles at the toe.

next.target: A widening apron of overlapping grey pebbles separates irregular pockets of upright reeds from the water.
next.current: A thin band of pale flat gravel meets an almost continuous carpet of rounded grass clumps.
next.change: Widen the pebble apron into the grass in uneven pockets, give the cobbles visible overlap and place taller reeds at the intervening waterside points.

next.target: Sloping shoulders emerge from bright broken foam that wraps each flank and narrows into trails.
next.current: The two tallest rocks have abrupt shoulders and the visible foam forms broad smoky patches near their bases.
next.change: Bevel the upper shoulders and concentrate brighter foam into thin branching lines that hug both flanks before trailing downstream.

excluded: Distant mountains and sky are outside this pass.
unverifiable: Water motion and vegetation motion cannot be judged from still captures.
